description: Fast command-line vector viewer for Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, GeoParquet, and KML/KMZ with attribute filtering and QGIS export.
rules: Treat viewgeom as a lightweight vector preview tool rather than a full GIS platform.
Use command-line examples for viewing, coloring by column, filtering, and exporting vector data.
For Claude Code users, mention the viewgeom skill at skills/viewgeom/SKILL.md and how to install it.
